decision: ADJUST_NEXT_EXPERIMENT; no product switch, install or semantic/quality pass
scope: Single A/B/A native-resource-access experiment on existing development Farm pp28-29 only; no reserved sample or new model execution
hypothesis_result: Persistent missing FontName content or a deterministic spaces-in-path defect is not supported: the original installed path succeeds unchanged after resource reads/copying. A resource-read/materialization state change is consistent with evidence, including two zero-byte temporary CMap copies, but the OS/filesystem root cause remains unverified. No font data was rewritten; only Farm Latin-script pages were tested.
hidden_heading_warning: Both Docling detected Criterion heading strings are covered native-layer text in already visually reviewed Farm pages. Native hierarchy profile confidence0.99 remains unsafe and is not a verified heading.
layout_boundary: DoclingPdfParser only supplies native cells/geometry/font/bitmap resources; no full docling DocumentConverter or learned layout used. Existing positioned config has layout.backend=heuristic.

package_copy_limit.finding: Two retained temporary CMap files are empty although the installed resources are nonempty. The source copy was not fully byte-identical; this copy is not an install/release candidate. No repair or further parser run performed.

usable_local_interfaces: NativeExtractor("docling-parse").extract(window_path) returns true word/textline/character/font evidence through the existing adapter.

routing.text_layer.native_analysis_page can consume the richer native cells; native_spacing.coalesce uses retained native character positions for font-fragment boundaries. These downstream benefits were not measured here.
